title: FactorIA song document (*.song.json)
description: Music composed as data: a tempo, a meter and a key, tracks (an instrument and named patterns of note text or drum grids each) and sections that say what every track plays. `music.create` writes a starting point, `music.edit` changes it, `music.check` finds problems, `music.preview` renders a WAV with the instruments and the mixer (`music.mix` shows the levels). Errors name the file, the JSON pointer and, inside note text, the line and column; docs/MUSIC.md has the notation.

doc.description: What the song is for and where the game plays it.

tempo.description: Quarter notes per minute (one tempo for the whole song).

meter.description: Time signature such as "4/4", "3/4", "6/8", "5/4": 1 to 16 beats of a half, quarter, eighth or sixteenth note.

key.description: The key's tonic note only: C, F#, Bb. The scale goes in `mode`.

mode.description: The scale notes are judged against (music.scale describes each).

swing.description: How far the off-beats are delayed toward a triplet feel: 0 straight, 1 full triplet.

swingGrid.description: Which off-beats swing: 8 for eighth notes, 16 for sixteenth notes.

seed.description: Picks the take of random arpeggios and of the drum kit's round-robin hits.

layers.description: Groups of tracks that a layered player brings in by intensity, and that `music.render` with `stems: "layers"` writes as one file each (docs/MUSIC.md "Layers and stems"). A track is in at most one layer; the tracks no layer names form the layer `other`, which cannot be named here. `music.edit` op set_layers changes it.

intensity.description: The music intensity (0 to 1) from which the layer plays: 0 is always on, 1 only at full intensity. Left out, the layers are spread evenly in the order written (the first at 0, the last at 1).

doc.description: What the layer adds to the music.

mixer.description: The mix: shared effect buses and the master (docs/MUSIC.md "The mixer"). `music.mix` shows what each did, `music.edit` op set_mixer changes it.

buses.description: Bus name (1 to 32 letters, digits, - or _) to bus. Tracks send to a bus by name; a bus returns only its effect (wet).

volume.description: Linear gain of the bus return.

mute.description: true silences the bus (the sends still exist).

effects.description: Effects of the bus, in order: usually one reverb or delay. At most 8.

items.description: One effect step, written like a step of an audio document (docs/SOUND.md "Audio documents"; audio.info lists the fields of each): {"type": "reverb", "decay": 1.8}. A reverb or delay on a track runs inside it; put one on a bus to share it.

enabled.description: false skips the effect without removing it.

effects.description: Effects of the master bus, after the song `volume`. At most 8.

items.description: One effect step, written like a step of an audio document (docs/SOUND.md "Audio documents"; audio.info lists the fields of each): {"type": "reverb", "decay": 1.8}. A reverb or delay on a track runs inside it; put one on a bus to share it.

enabled.description: false skips the effect without removing it.

limiter.description: The lookahead peak limiter: true (default, ceiling -1 dB), false to switch it off, or {ceilingDb, release}.

release.description: Seconds the gain takes to recover.

loudness.description: "style" (default) brings the mix to the music loudness of the project's style guide, "off" keeps the level the tracks add up to, or a target in LUFS (-40 to -5).

tracks.description: Track name (1 to 32 letters, digits, - or _) to track.

additionalProperties.description: One instrument and its named patterns.

instrument.description: What plays the track: a built-in instrument (music.instrument lists them by family: leads, pads, basses, plucks, bells, ensembles, chiptune), `kit`, `kit:electronic` or `kit:chiptune` for a drum kit, an sfx preset name, a project .sfx.json path, a SoundFont file `assets/x.sf2` (the first preset), `assets/x.sf2#Piano` (a preset by name) or `assets/x.sf2#0:25` (bank:program), or the object form {"soundfont": "assets/x.sf2", "preset": "Piano"}.

anyOf.description: Instrument name, patch path or SoundFont reference.

soundfont.description: Path of the .sf2 file inside the project, e.g. assets/audio/piano.sf2.

preset.description: Preset name, or program number 0 to 127 (with `bank`). Default: the first preset.

bank.description: Bank of a numbered preset (128 is the percussion bank). Default 0.

drums.description: true plays the SoundFont's percussion kit (bank 128) with the drum lanes of a grid pattern.

mute.description: true silences the track in every render (a section's `mute` silences it for one part).

solo.description: true plays only the tracks marked solo.

voices.description: How many notes may sound at once (ringing releases count); 0 uses the instrument's own limit. A later note cuts the oldest voice; a chord is never cut by its own notes.

effects.description: Insert effects of the track, in order, applied before the fader and the pan. At most 8.

items.description: One effect step, written like a step of an audio document (docs/SOUND.md "Audio documents"; audio.info lists the fields of each): {"type": "reverb", "decay": 1.8}. A reverb or delay on a track runs inside it; put one on a bus to share it.

enabled.description: false skips the effect without removing it.

sends.description: Bus name to how much of the track goes there (0 to 2): a shared reverb or delay. The bus is declared in the song's `mixer.buses`.

transpose.description: Semitones added to every pitched note.

swing.description: Swing of this track; overrides the song's.

range.description: [lowest, highest] note the part should stay in, as note names or MIDI numbers; music.check flags notes outside it.

kit.description: Drum tracks only: lane name to a .sfx.json patch that replaces that lane of the built-in kit (or adds a lane). Built-in lanes: kick, snare, clap, rim, hat, openhat, shaker, tom_low, tom_mid, tom_high, ride, crash.

additionalProperties.description: Path of the patch, e.g. assets/audio/my_kick.sfx.json.
A pattern: note text (pitched track), {notes, bars} (note text padded to a number of bars), or a drum grid.

anyOf.description: Note text (docs/MUSIC.md): notes `C4 F#3 Bb2`, durations `:4 :8 :4. :8t`, `r` rest, `[C4 E4 G4]` a chord of notes, `(Am7)` or `(Am7@3)` a chord by name, `|` a checked bar line, `{...}x2` repeat, `&` another voice; after a note `!` accent, `'` staccato, `~` tie, `v90` velocity.
Note text with a declared length in bars: a shorter text is padded with silence, a longer one is an error.

notes.description: Note text (docs/MUSIC.md): notes `C4 F#3 Bb2`, durations `:4 :8 :4. :8t`, `r` rest, `[C4 E4 G4]` a chord of notes, `(Am7)` or `(Am7@3)` a chord by name, `|` a checked bar line, `{...}x2` repeat, `&` another voice; after a note `!` accent, `'` staccato, `~` tie, `v90` velocity.

anyOf.description: A drum pattern: a step grid per lane.

grid.description: Lane name to step text: x hit, X accent, o soft ghost note, . - or _ rest; spaces and | are ignored. Lanes: kick, snare, clap, rim, hat, openhat, shaker, tom_low, tom_mid, tom_high, ride, crash, plus the lanes of the track's `kit`.

step.description: Note value of one grid step. Default 16.

bars.description: Length in bars; a shorter grid is padded with silence.

automation.description: Lanes over the song for this track.

items.description: One automation lane of the track.

param.description: What the lane moves: volume (0 to 2), pan (-1 to 1), filter (Hz, 40 to 20000) or macro.<name> of the instrument's patch.

points.description: [beat, value] pairs in time order; the beat counts quarter notes from the start of the song.

curve.description: How the value moves between points: linear, step (jumps at each point) or smooth.

items.description: A part of the song: which pattern every track plays and for how many repeats.

name.description: Name of the section (1 to 40 characters), unique in the song.

kind.description: intro plays once at the start, loop is the part that repeats in a game, outro plays once at the end. Later milestones use the kind for loop points and transitions.

repeat.description: The section plays this many times in a row.

bars.description: Length in bars. Default: the longest track of the section; a shorter track repeats to fill it, a longer one is cut.

mute.description: Tracks that stay silent in this section.

play.description: Track name to what it plays here (patterns in order).

additionalProperties.description: What a track plays in a section: patterns in order, `name*N` repeats one, `rest` is a silent bar. Text ("a a b*2 rest") or a list of the same tokens and objects.

anyOf.description: Entries separated by spaces: "a a b*2 rest*2".
The same entries as a list.
One or more entries as text.
A pattern and how many times it plays.

pattern.description: Name of a pattern of the track.

repeat.description: Times it plays in a row. Default 1.

items.description: One automation lane of the whole song.

param.description: What the lane moves: volume (0 to 2) or filter (Hz, 40 to 20000).

points.description: [beat, value] pairs in time order; the beat counts quarter notes from the start of the song.

curve.description: How the value moves between points: linear, step (jumps at each point) or smooth.
